--lua sim=require'sim'
-- Following script resets the second joint on the omni-wheel (important to achieve the desired omni-wheel effect)
function sysCall_init() rolling=sim.getObject('..') slipping=sim.getObject('../slippingJoint_rr') end
function sysCall_actuation() sim.setObjectOrientation(slipping|sim.handleflag_reljointbaseframe,{-math.pi/4,0,0},rolling) end

--lua sim=require'sim'
require 'configUi'
sim.setBufferProperty(sim.getObject('..'), 'customData.__schema__',sim.packTable{ xSize={ default=5, maximum=200, minimum=1, name="X size", type="float", ui={ control="spinbox", order=10,col=1 }, }, ySize={ default=5, maximum=200, minimum=1, name="Y size", type="float", ui={ control="spinbox", order=20,col=1 }, }, thickness={ default=0.2, maximum=1, minimum=0.05, name="Thickness", type="float", ui={ control="spinbox", order=30,col=2 }, }, height={ default=0.5, maximum=5, minimum=0.01, name="Height", type="float", ui={ control="spinbox", order=40,col=2 }, }, color={ type='color', name='Color', default={1,1,1}, ui={order=50,col=1,}, }, })
configUi=ConfigUI('ExternalWall',nil,function(config) local self=sim.getObject('..')
local children=sim.getObjectsInTree(self,sim.sceneobject_shape,1) sim.removeObjects(children)
local p=sim.createPrimitiveShape(sim.primitiveshape_cuboid,{config.xSize+config.thickness*2,config.thickness,config.height}) sim.setObjectColor(p,0,sim.colorcomponent_ambient_diffuse,config.color) sim.setObjectPosition(p,{0,-config.ySize*0.5-config.thickness*0.5,config.height*0.5}) local all={p} p=sim.copyPasteObjects({p},0)[1] sim.setObjectPosition(p,{0,config.ySize*0.5+config.thickness*0.5,config.height*0.5}) all[2]=p p=sim.createPrimitiveShape(sim.primitiveshape_cuboid,{config.thickness,config.ySize+config.thickness*2,config.height}) sim.setObjectColor(p,0,sim.colorcomponent_ambient_diffuse,config.color) sim.setObjectPosition(p,{-config.xSize*0.5-config.thickness*0.5,0,config.height*0.5}) all[3]=p p=sim.copyPasteObjects({p},0)[1] sim.setObjectPosition(p,{config.xSize*0.5+config.thickness*0.5,0,config.height*0.5}) all[4]=p p=sim.groupShapes(all) sim.setObjectParent(p,self,true) local prop=sim.getObjectProperty(p) sim.setObjectProperty(p,(prop|sim.objectproperty_selectable|sim.objectproperty_ignoreviewfitting)-sim.objectproperty_selectable) sim.setBoolProperty(p, 'respondable', true) end)
configUi.getObjectCallback = function() return sim.getObject '..' end
